metadata.description: Astro dev server with HMR for the QAuth documentation site (Starlight).
Static build of the QAuth documentation site. Output lands at dist/apps/docs-site via astro.config.mjs's outDir.

Overrides the @nx/vitest-inferred target's `inputs` (which only covers {projectRoot}/**/* — this project's own files). Three of this project's invariants tests read outside apps/docs-site at runtime: status-claims.test.ts reads README.md and docs/README.md, and endpoint-coverage.test.ts reads apps/auth-server/src/app/routes/**. Without declaring those here, editing any of them left this target's cache hash unchanged, so a fixed guard replayed a stale cached pass instead of re-running against the new content (issue #350 fix-round-1 finding). Setting `inputs` on an already-inferred target REPLACES the inferred array rather than merging into it, so the first six entries above are the inferred defaults re-declared, not new — drop one and its category of input silently stops being hashed.

Type-check via `astro check` (checks .astro/.mdx content through Astro's language server, not just tsc). Overrides the @nx/js/typescript-inferred target, which fails on this project (see Task 1 report: TS5069 without composite/declaration, then TS2883 from docsSchema()/Zod v4 under declaration-emit).
Preview the static build of the QAuth documentation site (serves dist/apps/docs-site).
